- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)

- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus

**3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d) **

Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following two positions in the Department of Palaeontology & Historical Geology and the Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01 January 2027

3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d)

(full time / part time)

Location: Frankfurt (Hesse)

Organizational units:

Department of Palaeontology & Historlcal Geology, Section Amber Research

Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology, Section Palaeomammalogy

Department of Palaeoanthropology, Section Mammalogy

Employment scope: Full-time / Part-time

Type of contract: Project-based, fixed-term for three years

Remuneration: Collective agreement of Hesse, TV-H E 9

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.

Within the framework of the project "SCRE3NED: Senckenberg Collection's RarEst – 3-dimensioNal Enhanced Digitisation", type specimens of exceptional scientific value (holotypes, paratypes and lectotypes) from various collections of the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt (amber, extant and fossil mammals, Messel fossils) are digitised using micro-computed tomography (μCT), synchrotron radiation-based micro-computed tomography (SRμCT), and digital photography. The aim is to produce high-quality, standardised and FAIR-compliant 2D and 3D datasets for research, collection management and science communication.

- Supporting the preparation and execution of SRμCT scanning campaigns at external research facilities
- Reconstruction, segmentation and quality control of 3D image datasets
- Contributing to the implementation of photography-based digitisation methods

Desirable skills

- Familiarity with the FAIR principles and experience with repositories for 3D data (e.g., MorphoSource) or with collection databases

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As an Expert Business Partner (f/m/d), you will be a key finance business partner within the TI Compression Business Controlling team. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior management, you will ensure financial transparency, challenge business performance, and provide actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the consolidation, validation, and submission of forecasts while steering monthly reporting, preliminary actuals, and quarterly closing activities
* Lead and coordinate annual budgeting and long-term financial planning processes across multiple entities and stakeholders
* Own the analysis of actuals, forecasts, budgets, and prior-period results, identifying key business drivers, variances, risks, and opportunities
* Challenge and translate financial results into actionable business insights and develop compelling narrative reporting for senior management
* Act as a strategic finance partner to Controllers, Business Departments, Functional Stakeholders, and CP Management, including interaction with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Drive global continuous improvements across planning, reporting, data quality, and forecasting accuracy while leading cross-functional and international initiatives

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
* Significant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Business Controlling, or Corporate Finance, ideally gained in medium-sized to large international organizations; M&A experience is a plus
* Strong international and cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to lead and influence stakeholders across functions, entities, and cultures
* Strong understanding of financial statements, business drivers, and performance metrics, ideally gained in a manufacturing, industrial, or project-driven environment
* Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing 
electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We 
enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and 
integrated execution capabilities

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About Infront

At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets. 

For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. 

Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed. 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially focused Pre-Sales Specialist to support the growth of our Infront Quant Valuation & Risk offering (IQ Risk) and our independent Valuation Services across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Luxembourg.

Working as a trusted advisor alongside regional Sales Executives, you will engage with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle, demonstrating how our multi-asset risk analytics and independent valuation services address the complex needs of banks, asset managers, insurers, pension funds, fund administrators, AIFMs, family offices and institutional investors.

This is a quota-carrying role with co-prime responsibility for the achievement of sales targets for the in-scope Valuation & Risk product suite. Success requires a combination of strong business acumen, quantitative and financial markets expertise, regulatory knowledge, and the ability to articulate business value to both executive and operational stakeholders.

This position is based in Frankfurt am Main, where you will work closely with our quant analysts, model developers, and valuation service specialists, gaining direct access to the expertise behind IQ Risk and our independent valuation offerings.

As our Pre-Sales Specialist, you will:

- Partner with Regional Sales Executives to develop account strategies, drive revenue growth, and support commercial negotiations across assigned territories.
- Qualify client business, functional, quantitative, and technical requirements, contributing to opportunity planning, competitive positioning, and solution design.
- Deliver demonstrations, proof of concepts, valuation benchmarks, solution proposals, and technical validation activities tailored to client needs.
- Lead discovery workshops to understand valuation policies, risk measurement processes, market data requirements, and regulatory obligations.
- Design and present solution architectures, including API, data feed, and file-based integrations, that align client requirements with product capabilities.
- Act as a subject matter expert for valuation methodologies, risk analytics, and relevant regulatory frameworks, while positioning Infront Quant's independent approach against alternative solutions.
- Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across investments, risk, valuation, operations, compliance, fund accounting, and technology functions, articulating the business value and ROI of our solutions to audiences ranging from end users to executive leadership.
- Collaborate closely with Quant Analytics, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams, sharing market and regulatory insights to support product development, competitive positioning, and sales success.
- Travel regularly across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Luxembourg to support client meetings, workshops, industry events, and internal collaboration.

Who you are

- Proven experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Solution Engineering supporting enterprise SaaS, financial technology, or quantitative analytics solutions.
- Strong understanding of valuation, risk analytics, capital markets, and financial instruments, ideally across fixed income, derivatives, and structured products.
- Experience supporting complex, consultative B2B sales cycles and engaging with senior business and technical stakeholders.
- Excellent presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
Ability to translate business, regulatory, and operational challenges into effective technology and service solutions.
- Commercially minded with experience working toward revenue targets or shared sales objectives.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both business and technical audiences.
- Self-motivated and comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
- Knowledge of valuation and risk management solutions, market data vendors, APIs, cloud technologies, quantitative risk concepts, and RFP/RFI processes is advantageous.
- Fluent German and English are essential; additional European language skills are considered a strong advantage.
- A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, as well as professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, CAIA, or equivalent, are considered a strong advantage.

Our Offer

**Health & wellness:** Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.

**Holiday:** Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.

**Pension:** Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions.

**Remote work:** Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.

**Learning & development:** Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.

**Culture & impact:** Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.

**Our offices:** Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.

Additional notes

*Note: Since your application will be reviewed by an international team, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

All candidates selected for employment are subject to pre-employment screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.

jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

jobs.occupation: Research Software Engineer (all genders) HPC Code Performance Optimisation (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position as

Research Software Engineer (all genders)

HPC Code Performance Optimisation

Your tasks

DKRZ plays a significant role in a number of projects with the aim of advancing Earth System Modelling (ESM). This facilitates the advancement of scientific knowledge in the fields of Earth system modelling and climate research. In the context of the current development of digital twins of the Earth, it is necessary to adapt increasingly complex models and corresponding software to the most powerful HPC systems in Europe and ensure that those codes run stable and efficiently.

As a member of the team of Research Software Engineers (RSEs), you will collaborate with Earth System scientists to overcome technical challenges in high-performance computing (HPC) and software development. Your responsibilities will include further developing, testing and optimising existing coupled Earth System models. This will allow them to be extended with new components (e.g. ice sheet models) without compromising the efficient execution time. This is a key challenge, given the need to use resources effectively on current and future HPC systems. For this position, we are looking for candidates who are interested in the interdisciplinary implementation of Earth System models and who want to apply their programming skills to new challenges.

Qualifications / Experiences

•Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering or related fields with a focus on scientific computing

•Strong interest in and experience with HPC-systems and parallel programming with MPI/OpenMP

•Knowledge of programming with C/C++ and/or Fortran under UNIX/LINUX and scripting languages

•Experience in the use and programming of GPU systems for scientific applications is an advantage

•Experience in algorithms, data structures and design of scientific software is welcome

•Very good communication skills and knowledge of English

Employment conditions

We offer opportunities to work in interdisciplinary teams and have excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific implementation and support requirements from our users and project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to work creatively at the interface between applied computer science and the development of scientific applications. Attendance at international conferences, project meetings and hackathons facilitate further training and the presentation of your own results.

Our company is headquartered in Hamburg, but we are committed to creating a flexible working environment. We offer a remote working option, with the possibility of working from home up to 100% within Germany. Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. The ideal commencement date would be September 2026, although this is flexible and can be discussed on an individual basis. The position is funded by a third-party project, with a limited initial timeframe until the end of 2028.

Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portalhttps://dkrz.softgarden.io/en/vacancies

Application deadline: Open until filled. Priority will be given to applications received by 23 August 2026

Questions? Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.

jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Exploration, Space Safety and Space Transportation (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

In this role, you will be responsible for the holistic systems engineering of complex space missions, from early concept phases through to verification. You will analyze customer, mission and system requirements and translate them into structured specifications, including the development of functional architectures and identification of required adaptations.

A key part of your work will involve the derivation and management of requirements down to subsystem and equipment level using DOORS, as well as supporting trade-offs and shaping the overall mission and system architecture. You will actively contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering everything from mission analysis to subsystem specifications.

You will coordinate technical activities across subsystems and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment in case of requirement changes and assessing their impact. In addition, you will act as a key interface to subcontractors (on behalf of the Project Chief Engineer or Project Manager) as well as to external partners, including industry and ESA.

Your responsibilities also include supporting system design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), verification planning and the monitoring of requirement compliance. You will contribute to defining verification strategies, preparing test specifications and evaluating test results. Furthermore, you will support the implementation of design changes (e.g. RFWs, RFDs, NCRs) and contribute to the preparation of proposals for future exploration missions.
Your Qualifications

You hold a degree (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or a comparable qualification and bring a solid foundation in systems engineering. You have experience in requirements analysis, specification development and the definition of system architectures, ideally complemented by knowledge of interface management.

Practical experience in areas such as exploration, space safety or space transportation is a strong asset. Beyond your technical expertise, you demonstrate strong communication skills and feel comfortable working in international, interdisciplinary teams within structured project environments.

Your strengths include creativity, a solution-oriented mindset and the ability to navigate complex challenges effectively.

You are confident communicating in English; German language skills are an advantage.

Your Tasks

Overall space system means space plus ground plus launch segments.
Main responsibilities

- Perform analyses of space segment or overall space system functional and interface requirements
- Coordinate overall space system validation and verification on system level
- Internal customer for spacecraft data bases and simulators
- Ensure compliance to the technical requirements

Work in collaboration with Architects and Subsystem engineers

- Technical system budgets (electrical power, propellant, telemetry, command, pointing, mass properties)
- Define the overall space system configuration and manage the internal and external interfaces (e.g. launcher, ground, user interfaces)
- Flow down of the mission requirements to subsystem level specifications
- Define Verification plans
- Support the generation of AIT plans and operation plans
- Supervise preparation of overall space system and spacecraft tests and review of test results
- Define Test Specifications for overall space system and spacecraft Tests
- Responsible for maintenance of spacecraft data bases
- Preparation for launch and flight phases, preparation of launcher interfaces
- Contribute to the project risk management for risks of technical nature
Your Qualifications

- Degree in engineering, physics or equivalent
- Professional experience in satellite projects, preferably in phases B/C/D
- Good conceptual and problem-solving skills
- Well-developed communication and negotiation skills
- High motivation, pro-active working approach and strong sense of responsibility
- Team-minded and ideally accustomed to work in internationally composed team
- Fluency in both spoken and written English, German language skills are highly desirable

You are interested in this position but don’t meet all the requirements or lack experience? No problem! These are all tasks to be covered by the team. On which task you will start will be discussed during interview

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.

jobs.occupation: The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as Junior Researcher / Pr (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as

Junior Researcher / PreDoc (Kiel or Berlin)

We are looking for up to two highly motivated Junior Researchers / PreDocs to join our dynamic research team at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy. The positions are almost full-time (75-90 percent). One position should be based in Kiel and another one optional in Kiel or in our Research Hub in Berlin. Both positions are linked to the research group by Prof. Christoph Trebesch and his ERC project on Great Power Finance.

The two positions have the following focus, respectively:

1. Digital chokepoints: geopolitical risk and telecom networks
2. International capital flows: great powers and cross-border investments across 200 years 

Your Role 

Your main role will be to contribute to cutting-edge research on one or two of the projects. The work will involve extensive data collection and rigorous empirical analysis using historical and contemporary sources. A particular focus of these roles will be archival research and the construction of novel datasets from historical records and documents related to telecommunications, computer science, financial assets and international capital flows.

As part of Christoph Trebesch’s research group, you will work closely with senior researchers on high-impact projects in macroeconomics, economic history, and political economy. The positions offer an excellent opportunity to gain advanced research experience, develop strong empirical skills, and contribute to internationally visible academic work.

Your Profile 

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

- ·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics (completed or close to completion) with very good grades.
- ·         Strong quantitative and empirical skills and experience, particularly:
- For position (1): experience with data on telecommunication and computer science
- For position (2): experience with data on financial assets and/or international capital flows, ideally also historical financial data
- ·         Experience with advanced AI tools and statistical software such as Stata, R, and/or Python.
- ·         Interest in historical research and archival work.
- ·         Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment. 
- ·         Excellent analytical and organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality research.
- The working language is English; excellent English skills are therefore required. Some knowledge of German would be useful, but is not important.

We are offering 

The planned contract period is 10 months (starting in the fall of 2026). The salary will be based on the German public sector pay scale at grade EG 12 or 13 TV L. The position is part-time between 75-90%.

The Kiel Institute for the World Economy values diversity. We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age or sexual orientation. The Kiel Institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/equal-opportunity/) . We promote the professional opportunities of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Women with equivalent qualifications, competence and expertise will be given preference. We are committed to employing persons with recognized disabilities and will therefore give them preference over persons without disabilities if they are equally qualified. 

In order to be eligible for this position you have to hold EU citizenship or need to be able to provide a work permit that is valid throughout the time of your contract.

Please submit your application online (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/job-vacancies/junior-researcher-/-predoc-kiel-or-berlin/) using ID-No. “PreDoc_2026”. Please include (i) a letter of interest, (ii) your CV, (iii) one or two work samples (e.g. Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis), (iv) university transcripts, as well as (if applicable) (v) proofs of relevant work experience. Ideally submit just one PDF, including “PreDoc” and your family name as file name. The deadline for applications is September 7, 2026 Application photos should not be included. 

For additional information, please contact Prof. Christoph Trebesch (christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de (https://mailto:christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de) ).

jobs.description:
PhD candidate in the Research Department Nanooptics (f/d/m) in Jena

The Leibniz Institute of Photonics Technology (Leibniz IPHT (https://www.leibniz-ipht.de/en/homepage/) ) offers the following position in the Research Department Nanooptics (https://www.leibniz-ipht.de/en/departments/nanooptics/) for a part-time (65%) position, starting as soon as possible:

PhD candidate (f/m/d)

The position is initially limited to 3 years. An extension will be sought if suitable.

The Leibniz-IPHT is a university independent research institute with close connection to the Friedrich-Schiller-University Jena (https://www.uni-jena.de/en) and member of the Leibniz association (https://www.leibniz-gemeinschaft.de/en/institutes/leibniz-institutes-all-lists) .

Job description:

The PhD candidate is expected to join us to work on the research project “Light-driven microdrones”, which is based on the collaboration between Dr. Xiaofei Wu at Leibniz-IPHT and Prof. Bert Hecht at University of Würzburg. Light-driven microdrones are micrometer-sized robots actuated by multiple independent optical nanomotors, which generate thrusts upon light illumination. Up to date, we have developed microdrones working in a plane with full and independent controls in all 3 degrees of freedom of 2D motions, which is a breakthrough for light-driven robotic devices (see https://communities.springernature.com/posts/light-driven-microdrones-a-new-level-of-optical-manipulation).

We are now aiming to extend the operation space of the microdrones to 3D. The two PhD candidates at Leibniz-IPHT and University of Würzburg will work together to achieve this goal by fulfilling a few challenging tasks. Once the whole microdrone system is established, we will perform experiments to showcase the great potential of the microdrones for future applications. The current idea is to do tip-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (TERS) of cells or similar specimens.

Your field of activity includes:

- Use numerical simulations (FDTD, COMSOL, deep learning) to design efficient nanomotors of the microdrones for 3D control
- Develop microfluidic chips as experimental platform of the microdrones. Fabricate the microfluidic chips using photolithography and 3D nano/microprinting (e.g. Nanoscribe).
- Contribute to fabrications of the microdrones using FIB, EBL, transfer, etc.
- Conduct the experiments of TERS on biological specimens

Qualification:

- Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or related fields (such as biophotonics, nanotechnology).

Desired skills and abilities

- Enthusiasm in research of frontier science and technology
- Strong problem-solving drive and ambition for excellence
- Solid knowledge in electromagnetics and optics
- Experience in optical experiments
- Experience in programming (Python, Matlab, etc.) is a plus
- Experience in micro/nanofabrication is a plus
- Good communication skills in English (spoken and written)
- Independence, responsibility and team player

We offer:

- An open welcoming culture and an inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment: Located on the Beutenberg campus in Jena, Leibniz-IPHT is home to more than 400 employees from around the world working at the interface of physics, biochemistry, technology, data science and medicine to develop the photonic technologies of tomorrow.
- World-class equipment and facilities: Leibniz-IPHT has a large number of physics, chemistry and biology laboratories at the highest level. It also has state-of-the-art fiber drawing and clean room facilities (including lithography facilities) as well as microfluidics fabrication and big data computing facilities.
- Thorough and comprehensive personal training: Transferring good practices in scientific working and outreach is one of our main focus points. In a respectful and appreciative environment, you will learn everything you need for a career inside and outside of science. Moreover, plenty of workshops and opportunities for scientific exchange are offered by the Leibniz IPHT, as well as the Abbe School of Photonics and the Graduate Academy of the Friedrich-Schiller University Jena.
- A family-friendly working environment with support offers for the compatibility of family and work (e.g. parent-child office, campus kindergarten places, advice on family care situations from trained care guides and much more).
- Flexible working time models as well as 30 days vacation/year, special annual payment and bridge days.
- Jena - City of Science: a young city with a vibrant local cultural agenda!

Salary:

Salary is in accordance with the regulations of the TV-L and your qualifications and experience.

About us:

We are a modern, internationally focused research institute. Work-life balance is one of our central concerns. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality or ethnic and social origin. If women are underrepresented in the area of the advertised position, they will be given preferential consideration in the hiring process if they are equally qualified.

We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x) Biology (Life Sciences) for Preclinical Imaging

Radiochemie TV-L: 38,5 h/week (100%) 1-year fixed-term contract under the WissZeitVG; plus a 1-year extension for a third-party funded project
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks
• Planning, conducting and analyzing the biological evaluation of newly developed PET and SPECT radiotracers
• Contributing to the establishment, optimization and
documentation of biological test systems and preclinical evaluation protocols
• Performing in vitro studies, including stability, binding and cellular uptake assays as well as studies using models of the blood-brain-barrier
• Preclinical evaluation of tracer candidates in suitable in vivo models, including support of small-animal imaging studies
• Performing and analyzing ex vivo studies, e.g., autoradiography, biodistribution studies and complementary tissue analyses
• Quantitative analysis of biological and imaging data and
interpretation of results in close interaction with the other project partners
• Evaluation, documentation, and scientific presentation of experimental results in project reports, publications, and presentations

Your profile
• Completed university degree and Ph.D. in biology, life sciences, neuroscience, biochemistry, pharmacy or a related field
• Experience in preclinical imaging (e.g. small animal PET, SPECT, MRI, CT)
• Experience with animal models and experimental animal work is advantageous (FELASA-B or EU functions A, C, D)
• Experience with cell culture, in vitro assays, autoradiography, ex vivo analyses and BBB models is desirable
• Interest in radiopharmaceutical tracer development, molecular imaging and translational research
• Willingness to work with unsealed radioactive substances and to become familiar with radiation protection-related workflows
• Willingness to conduct biological and preclinical experiments within an interdisciplinary team
• Good written and spoken English skills
• Structured, independent and conscientious working style
• Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills and interest in interdisciplinary collaboration between chemistry, radiochemistry, biology, medicine and imaging

Our offer
• Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.
• Work-life balance: Whether full-time or part-time, with or without children – with numerous support options, we will find the right path together.
• Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.
• Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.

Your future with us
We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail
The Institute of Radiochemistry and Experimental Molecular Imaging (IREMB) is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a translational research project in the field of radiopharmaceutical tracer development and molecular imaging. The postdoc position will initially be embedded for one year in the internationally funded IMAGESTRO project. There is an option of extension for another year. The focus of the work will be on the biological validation of newly developed PET or SPECT radiotracers.
The IMAGESTRO project aims to develop novel 18F-labeled PET tracers for the non-invasive imaging of estrogen receptors in the brain, to characterize them preclinically, and to translate them into human applications. The project focuses on the organic synthesis of suitable precursor and reference compounds, the development and optimization
of radiofluorination strategies, and the comprehensive analytical and preclinical characterization of the resulting radiotracers. The work will be carried out in close cooperation between the University Hospital Cologne and Forschungszentrum Jülich and offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of organic chemistry, radiochemistry, radiopharmacy, molecular imaging, biology and neuroscience.

Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification. The position is suitable for staffing with part-time employees.

jobs.description:
Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region – home to the RMU Alliance formed by JGU, Goethe University, and TU Darmstadt – JGU can utilize its full potential and showcase its dynamic, innovative power. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching at JGU, in turn, paving the way for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its faculties and departments are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center, creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from all over the world.

The Institute of Developmental Biology and Neurobiology at the Faculty of Biology invites applications for the position of a

University Professor of Functional Genomics and Molecular Neurobiology

beginning at the earliest date possible. Salary grade W 2 LBesG | Civil servant (tenured)

Tasks and expectations:

We seek an outstanding candidate with a strong expertise in genetics and molecular biology, including the application of these approaches to the nervous system. Internationally recognised expertise and a strong track record of successfully securing external funding are required. Collaboration within the Faculty of Biology, the University Medical Centre, the Institute of Molecular Biology (IMB) and participation in current and future research consortia is expected.

The successful candidate will receive departmental positions and start-up funds and will be expected to establish an independent and internationally visible research program sustained by third party funding. Examples of further cooperation opportunities include: Institute of Quantitative and Computational Biosciences (IQCB) as well as collaborative research centres (e.g. CRC 1361 DNA Repair & Genome Stability; CRC 1551 Polymer Concepts in Cellular Function), the Research Unit FOR 5289 (From Imprecision to Robustness in Neural Circuit Assembly), or the Research Training Groups 4R (R-Loop Regulation in Robustness and Resilience) and GenEvo (Gene regulation in Evolution), the Carl-Zeiss-funded project for Interactive Bio-materials for Neural Regeneration and profile areas such as ReALity (Resilience - Adaptation - Longevity) or the Centre of Healthy Aging (further details here). The Rhine-Main Neuroscience Network (rmn²) offers further collaboration opportunities within the Rhine Main region.

Finally, the successful candidate will teach practical and theoretical courses in genetics, molecular biology and neurobiology at the Bachelor’s and Master’s level. We seek to increase the number of courses taught in English. Teaching is conducted in English and, in the basic Bachelor modules, in German. jobs.occupation: Professorship in One Health, Animal Hygiene and Animal Disease Control (W3) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine seeks to fill the mentioned above professorship at the earliest opportunity:

Academic context
Founded in 1409, the University of Leipzig is one of Germany's largest, most research-intensive and leading medical universities. It offers a dynamic and international working environment as well as attractive and diverse career opportunities in research, teaching, transfer, infrastructure and administration. The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine serves as a centre for interdisciplinary research in the fields of animal health, veterinary public health, public health and One Health.

The Institute of Animal Hygiene and Public Veterinary Services is a member of the Centre for Veterinary Public Health at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine. It has modern BSL-2 (Biosafety Level 2) laboratory facilities, an interdisciplinary research environment and a wide-ranging international network.

Future Duties
The professorship is responsible for independently representing the field of animal hygiene and animal disease control in teaching [in accordance with § 32 "Animal husbandry and animal hygiene" and § 39 "Animal disease control and infectious disease epidemiology" of the Ordinance on the Licensing of Veterinarians (Verordnung zur Approbation von Tierärztinnen und Tierärzten – TAppV)], research and services. In the subject of animal disease control, teaching is carried out in cooperation with the Centre for Infectious Diseases (Zentrum für Infektionsmedizin – ZIM). The professorship is also responsible for managing the Institute of Animal Hygiene and Veterinary Public Health.

The professorship is expected to strengthen the faculty's research profile, especially the One Health approach, and to focus on the rapid detection and containment of infectious diseases in animals, animal epidemics and zoonoses (Pandemic Preparedness). Compatibility and collaboration in the research priorities of the faculty (www.vetmed.uni-leipzig.de/forschung/forschungsschwerpunkte) and university (www.uni-leipzig.de/en/research/research-profile/strategic-orientation-of-our-research; www.uni-leipzig.de/en/newsdetail/artikel/strategic-research-profiling-leipzig-university-designates-eleven-emerging-fields-along-the-leipzig-way-2025-12-17) and the development of interdisciplinary and international clusters are expressly desired.

A teaching and research concept demonstrating the relevance of the planned projects to the research priorities of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and other university institutions should be submitted with the application.

Requirements
In addition to in-depth knowledge of classical animal hygiene combined with modern, technology-based strategies for disease control, outstanding research and publication achievements, particularly in the fields of animal hygiene and/or infection epidemiology, experience in teaching and the successful acquisition of competitive third-party funding, especially international joint research projects are expected. Extensive experience in teaching and postgraduate continuing education and training, experience in personnel management and development are required. Proof of a veterinary licence and approval as a veterinary specialist for animal hygiene or in a relevant field, as well as proof of a postdoctoral qualification or equivalent achievements, must be provided.

The job holder’s rights and obligations are regulated by the Saxon Higher Education Act (SächsHSG) and the Saxon Service Regulations for Higher Education Institutions (HSDAVO). Applicants must meet the requirements of § 59 SächsHSG.

Research, teaching, transfer, infrastructure and administration require a diversity of perspectives. The university is therefore committed to diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome your application, regardless of gender, nationality, religion, cultural and social background, age or sexual orientation. The university aims to increase the proportion of women in academia and therefore expressly encourages qualified women to apply.

Severely disabled persons – or persons deemed legally equal to them under Book IX of the German Social Code – are encouraged to apply and will be given preference in the case of equal suitability. If you have any questions about accessibility or need assistance with this application process, please contact Leipzig University’s disability officers at: schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de.

Please apply in English by 17 September 2026 exclusively via Leipzig University’s recruitment portal (http://www.uni-leipzig.de/berufungen)

Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail

We are a dedicated translational research group focused on understanding the fundamentals of human immune responses to viral pathogens and on developing novel strategies for the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases. Our work combines cutting-edge immunology, virology, antibody engineering, and translational research approaches to address clinically relevant questions in viral infections.
This PhD project focuses on the investigation of AAV-based strategies to effectively target HIV-1 using broadly neutralizing antibodies. A central goal of the project is to develop novel approaches for enabling in vivo expression of bNAb combinations that overcome limitations of AAV packaging capacity. The project will involve the design and detailed characterization of multispecific bNAb-derived constructs, the in vivo validation of AAV-mediated protein expression, and the analysis of antiviral activity as well as viral evolution in HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative environment with access to state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure and clinical research networks.
Your work will contribute to a deeper understanding of antibody activity against HIV-1 as well as viral escape mechanisms, and support the development of innovative preventive and therapeutic strategies.
Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification.

jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About this opportunity

In the position of a (Junior) Software Engineer (f/m/d) in Life Science and Diagnostics at QIAGEN, you will be making improvements in life possible – every working day. We are looking for you to help us shape our product development with skill and passion. You will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control software for laboratory devices as well as data analysis software to process test results helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample.

Your Tasks
* As a Software Engineer you will typically work in project teams of 5-10 people and gain experience in different roles throughout the life cycle of a software development project.
* You will start as a software developer or (automated) software tester in one of our scrum teams. Throught your professional career you will have the opportunity to grow into senior roles such as senior engineer, product owner, software architect or verification manager.  
* You will work across teams and across sites to generate the best possible solution for our products in a complex environment of Biology, Chemistry, Mechanics, Electronics and Software.
* You will be based at QIAGEN Hilden, our operational headquarter and will have the opportunity to visit our international development sites in Aarhus, Denmark or Wroclaw, Poland to strengthen and refine your software development capabilities.

Your Profile
* You have a master’s degree in computer science, with a minor in medicine, science or engineering
* You show a strong interest in software and product development and have already gained first professional experience.
* You love science and have a strong analytical mindset that strives to analyze, understand and solve problems.
* You are highly organized, work independently and easily adapt to changing work environment.
* You show excellent communication skills in both, English and German (C1 level)
* Ideally, you are familiar with working with AI-powered development tools or large language models to automate software development lifecycle processes. Experience with connecting AI agents with third-party systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus

Please provide a transcript of record and an employer's reference if applicable.

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

Your responsibilities:

- As Media Partnership Coordinator you build and maintain strong relationships with media partners to increase brand awareness and attract existing and prospective B2B customers.
- You support the creation, formatting, and distribution of partner-related emails, newsletters, and follow-up communications using marketing tools and templates.
- Furthermore, you coordinate print advertising placements, assist with content submissions, and help ensure the smooth execution of media campaigns.
- The maintenance and updating media partner databases, monitoring partnership performance, and preparing reports and analyses on marketing activities belong to your regular tasks.
- You assist with budget tracking, invoice processing, and purchase orders to ensure marketing activities remain aligned with approved budgets.
- Also you support sponsorship initiatives, contribute to translations of media content and business documents, and compile press clippings and coverage reports on product launches and reviews.

You bring along:

- You bring at least 1 year of experience in marketing, media coordination, media planning, or a related field to the table, and are eager to develop your expertise in B2B marketing.
- You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and have hands-on experience with AI tools, newsletter platforms, social media channels, analytics, and reporting.
- By having strong analytical skills and know how to gather, evaluate, and interpret relevant data, identify trends, you turn insights into actionable recommendations.
- You work in a structured and organized manner, manage priorities effectively, and reliably meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
- Taking initiative, showing a proactive mindset, and being motivated to contribute beyond your core responsibilities to support team and business success is self-explanatory to you.
- You communicate confidently in English (minimum B2 level) and build positive relationships through strong collaboration, customer focus, and excellent written and verbal communication skills. Additional language skills are a strong advantage.

What we offer:

- A secure job in a constantly growing company
- A multinational team with colleagues from all over the world and an agreeable working atmosphere within the Powersports industry
- Flexible working times in full and part-time and modern working equipment.
- Onboarding and support for new employees
- Regular employee events, excursions, guided motorcycle tours and special sales events
- Company bike leasing and a job ticket for the regional public transport
- Company health management with organized health days, check-ups, group sport activities, contribution to fitness center membership fee, etc.

Are YOU interested?

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

We value diversity and therefore welcome applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity.

jobs.occupation: Join Native Nanny – International Childcare Opportunities in Duisburg (Kinderbetreuer/in)
jobs.description:
At Native Nanny, we specialize in international childcare placements across Germany. We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.

We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Duisburg and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!

Your Responsibilities

- Provide loving, attentive, and safe care for children.
- Organize and structure daily routines with age-appropriate activities such as games, creative play, reading, or homework support.
- Accompany children to and from school, nursery, or extracurricular activities.
- Handle light, child-related housekeeping: meal prep, tidying play areas, laundry, etc.

Your Profile

- Experience with children or babies is essential. A background in education or childcare is a strong advantage.
- You’re caring, empathetic, and genuinely enjoy working with children.
- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.
- You have a friendly, open, and professional attitude.
- You speak English, French, Italian, or another common European language fluently.

Why Join Us?

- Bring your cultural diversity and language skills into a role where they truly make a difference.
- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.
- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.

If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!
